```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(gtsummary)
  library(psych)
  library(gt)
})

dat <- readr::read_csv(
  here("data", "analysis_simulated.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair = "minimal"
)

# Create output directories if absent
dir.create(here("output", "tables", "main"),          showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here("output", "tables", "supplementary"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("1", "2"), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    race = factor(race,
      levels = c("1","2","3","4","5","6"),
      labels = c("Native","Asian","Pacific","African American","White","Unknown")
    ),
    tbi.diagnosis  = factor(tbi.diagnosis,  levels = c("0", "1"), labels = c("No mTBI", "mTBI")),
    ptsd.diagnosis = factor(ptsd.diagnosis, levels = c("No PTSD", "PTSD"))
  )
```

# Table 1. Demographic and clinical characteristics.

```{r table1, echo=FALSE}
# Comorbid PTSD + mTBI count for Table 1 note
n_comorbid <- sum(dat$ptsd.diagnosis == "PTSD" & dat$tbi.diagnosis == "mTBI", na.rm = TRUE)

# Pre-compute range strings for continuous variables
make_range <- function(x) sprintf("%g \u2013 %g", min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
cont_ranges <- c(
  age                         = make_range(dat$age),
  ctq_totalscore              = make_range(dat$ctq_totalscore),
  pcl_total                       = make_range(dat$pcl_total),
  rpq13_total                     = make_range(dat$rpq13_total),
  phq9_score                  = make_range(dat$phq9_score)
)

table1 <- tbl_stack(
  list(
    dat %>%
      select(age, gender, race) %>%
      tbl_summary(
        missing = "no",
        percent = "column",
        type    = all_continuous() ~ "continuous",
        label   = list(
          age    ~ "Age (years)",
          gender ~ "Gender",
          race   ~ "Race"
        ),
        statistic = list(
          all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
          all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
        ),
        digits = all_continuous() ~ 2
      ) %>%
      add_n(),

    dat %>%
      select(ctq_totalscore, pcl_total, rpq13_total,
             ptsd.diagnosis, tbi.diagnosis, phq9_score) %>%
      tbl_summary(
        missing = "no",
        percent = "column",
        type    = all_continuous() ~ "continuous",
        label   = list(
          ctq_totalscore              ~ "CTQ",
          pcl_total                       ~ "PCL-C",
          rpq13_total                     ~ "RPQ-13",
          ptsd.diagnosis                  ~ "PTSD diagnosis",
          tbi.diagnosis                   ~ "mTBI diagnosis",
          phq9_score                  ~ "PHQ-9"
        ),
        statistic = list(
          all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
          all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
        ),
        digits = all_continuous() ~ 2
      ) %>%
      add_n()
  ),
  group_header = c("Demographic characteristics", "Clinical characteristics")
) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(
        Range = ifelse(
          row_type == "label" & var_type == "continuous",
          cont_ranges[variable],
          NA_character_
        ),
        n_level = ifelse(
          row_type == "level" & var_type == "categorical",
          str_match(stat_0, "^(\\d+)\\s*\\(([^)]+)\\)$")[, 2],
          NA_character_
        ),
        p_level = ifelse(
          row_type == "level" & var_type == "categorical",
          str_match(stat_0, "^(\\d+)\\s*\\(([^)]+)\\)$")[, 3],
          NA_character_
        ),
        stat_0 = ifelse(row_type == "level" & var_type == "categorical", p_level, stat_0)
      ) %>%
      rename(N = n) %>%
      mutate(n = ifelse(row_type == "level" & var_type == "categorical", n_level, NA_character_)) %>%
      select(-n_level, -p_level)
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    label  ~ "",
    N      ~ "**N**",
    n      ~ "**n**",
    stat_0 ~ "**Mean (SD);<br>% of total sample**",
    Range  ~ "**Range**"
  ) %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  cols_move(columns = c(n, stat_0, Range), after = N) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = html("<b>Table 1.</b> Demographic and clinical characteristics.")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(heading.align = "left") %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = html(
      paste0("<em>Note.</em> CTQ = Childhood Trauma Questionnaire; PCL-C = PTSD Checklist Civilian-Version; PCL-M = PTSD Checklist Military-Version; RPQ-13 = Rivermead Post-Concussion Symptoms Questionnaire; PHQ-9 = Patient Health Questionnaire-9. PTSD and mTBI diagnostic categories are not mutually exclusive; ", n_comorbid, " participants were comorbid for PTSD and mTBI.")
    )
  )

gtsave(table1, here("output", "tables", "main", "Table1_Demographics.html"))
table1
```

# Table S9. Prevalence of childhood maltreatment types.

```{r table_s9, echo=FALSE}
cut_ctq <- function(x, cuts) {
  cut(x, breaks = c(-Inf, cuts, Inf),
      labels = c("None", "Low", "Moderate", "Severe"),
      right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE)
}

dat_s9 <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    EN_cat = cut_ctq(ctq_emoneg_score, c(9, 13, 17)),
    PN_cat = cut_ctq(ctq_physneg_score, c(7, 9, 12)),
    EA_cat = cut_ctq(ctq_emo_score,     c(8, 12, 15)),
    PA_cat = cut_ctq(ctq_phys_score,    c(7, 9,  12)),
    SA_cat = cut_ctq(ctq_sex_score,     c(5, 7,  12))
  )

levs   <- c("None", "Low", "Moderate", "Severe")
tab_s9 <- list(
  `Emotional neglect` = prop.table(table(factor(dat_s9$EN_cat, levels = levs))) * 100,
  `Physical neglect`  = prop.table(table(factor(dat_s9$PN_cat, levels = levs))) * 100,
  `Emotional abuse`   = prop.table(table(factor(dat_s9$EA_cat, levels = levs))) * 100,
  `Physical abuse`    = prop.table(table(factor(dat_s9$PA_cat, levels = levs))) * 100,
  `Sexual abuse`      = prop.table(table(factor(dat_s9$SA_cat, levels = levs))) * 100
)

df_s9 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(tab_s9), function(nm) {
  out <- round(as.numeric(tab_s9[[nm]]), 1)
  data.frame(
    Subscale       = nm,
    `None (%)`     = out[1],
    `Low (%)`      = out[2],
    `Moderate (%)` = out[3],
    `Severe (%)`   = out[4],
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))

tbl_s9 <- df_s9 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = html("<b>Table S9.</b> Prevalence of childhood maltreatment types.")
  ) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_title(groups = "title")) |>
  cols_label(Subscale = "") |>
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = Subscale) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Subscale) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size                   = "small",
    source_notes.font.size            = "small",
    data_row.padding                  = px(2),
    heading.border.bottom.style       = "hidden",
    table.border.top.style            = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.style         = "solid",
    column_labels.border.top.style    = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table_body.border.bottom.style    = "solid"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(source_note = html(
    "<em>Note.</em> Values are percentages of participants within each severity category using CTQ manual cutoffs (Bernstein &amp; Fink, 1998; Bernstein et al., 2003)."
  ))

gtsave(tbl_s9, here("output", "tables", "supplementary", "TableS9_CTQ_Prevalence.html"))
tbl_s9
```

# Table S10. Summary of childhood maltreatment characteristics.

```{r table_s10, echo=FALSE}
measures <- tibble(
  Measure = c("CTQ total", "Emotional neglect", "Physical neglect",
              "Emotional abuse", "Physical abuse", "Sexual abuse"),
  col     = c("ctq_totalscore", "ctq_emoneg_score", "ctq_physneg_score",
              "ctq_emo_score",  "ctq_phys_score",   "ctq_sex_score"),
  dx_col  = c("ctq_diagnosis_total",
              "ctq_diagnosis_emoneg_score", "ctq_diagnosis_physneg_score",
              "ctq_diagnosis_emo_score",    "ctq_diagnosis_phys_score",
              "ctq_diagnosis_sex_score"),
  cutoff  = c("\u2265 41", "\u2265 13", "\u2265 10", "\u2265 15", "\u2265 10", "\u2265 8")
)

df_s10 <- measures %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    N           = sum(!is.na(dat[[col]])),
    `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)",
                          mean(dat[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(dat[[col]],   na.rm = TRUE)),
    Range       = sprintf("%g \u2013 %g",
                          min(dat[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                          max(dat[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_meet      = sum(as.numeric(dat[[dx_col]]) != 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct         = sprintf("%d%%", round(n_meet / nrow(dat) * 100))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Measure, N, `Mean (SD)`, Range, `Cut-off` = cutoff,
         n = n_meet, `% of total sample` = pct)

tbl_s10 <- df_s10 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = html("<b>Table S10.</b> Summary of childhood maltreatment characteristics.")
  ) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"),  locations = cells_title(groups = "title")) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = Measure)) |>
  cols_label(Measure = "") |>
  cols_align(align = "left",  columns = Measure) |>
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = -Measure) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size                   = "small",
    source_notes.font.size            = "small",
    data_row.padding                  = px(2),
    heading.border.bottom.style       = "hidden",
    table.border.top.style            = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.style         = "solid",
    column_labels.border.top.style    = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table_body.border.bottom.style    = "solid"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(source_note = html(
    "<em>Note.</em> CTQ, Childhood Trauma Questionnaire. This table displays frequencies of total childhood maltreatment and childhood maltreatment types according to the criteria for moderate exposure as outlined by Bernstein et al. (2003)."
  ))

gtsave(tbl_s10, here("output", "tables", "supplementary", "TableS10_CTQ_Summary.html"))
tbl_s10
```

# Table S11. Spearman correlations among CTQ subscales.

```{r table_s11, echo=FALSE}
vars <- c("ctq_emoneg_score", "ctq_physneg_score",
          "ctq_emo_score",    "ctq_phys_score",    "ctq_sex_score")

ct  <- psych::corr.test(dat[, vars], method = "spearman")
r   <- round(ct$r, 2)
p   <- ct$p
k   <- ncol(r)

stars <- function(x) ifelse(x < .001, "***", ifelse(x < .01, "**", ifelse(x < .05, "*", "")))
out   <- matrix("", k, k); diag(out) <- "\u2014"
idx   <- which(lower.tri(out), arr.ind = TRUE)
out[idx] <- paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r[idx]), stars(p[idx]))

rowlabs <- c("1. Emotional neglect", "2. Physical neglect", "3. Emotional abuse",
             "4. Physical abuse",    "5. Sexual abuse")

tab_s11 <- data.frame(
  Subscale = rowlabs,
  `1. EN`  = out[, 1], `2. PN` = out[, 2], `3. EA` = out[, 3],
  `4. PA`  = out[, 4], `5. SA` = out[, 5],
  check.names = FALSE
)

tbl_s11 <- tab_s11 |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = html(paste0(
      "<b>Table S11.</b> Spearman correlations among CTQ subscales (<i>N</i> = ", nrow(dat), ")."
    ))
  ) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"),  locations = cells_title(groups = "title")) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = Subscale)) |>
  cols_label(Subscale = "") |>
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = Subscale) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Subscale) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size                   = "small",
    source_notes.font.size            = "small",
    data_row.padding                  = px(2),
    heading.border.bottom.style       = "hidden",
    table.border.top.style            = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.style         = "solid",
    column_labels.border.top.style    = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table_body.border.bottom.style    = "solid"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(source_note = html(
    "<em>Note.</em> Values are Spearman\u2019s \u03c1. Lower triangle shown; diagonal entries are em dashes. EN = Emotional Neglect; PN = Physical Neglect; EA = Emotional Abuse; PA = Physical Abuse; SA = Sexual Abuse. *<em>p</em> < .05, **<em>p</em> < .01, ***<em>p</em> < .001."
  ))

gtsave(tbl_s11, here("output", "tables", "supplementary", "TableS11_CTQ_Correlations.html"))
tbl_s11
```
